<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_VascularProcedure"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vascular-procedure">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VascularProcedure" name="Vascular Procedure" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Procedure" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareImplements" name="Prepare implements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WashHands" name="Wash hands"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetSterileClothes" name="Get in sterile clothes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CleanPunctureArea" name="Clean puncture area"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrapePunctureZone" name="Drape puncture zone"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" name="Configure ultrasound"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PutGelInProbe" name="Put gel in probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CoverProbe" name="Cover probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PutSterileGel" name="Put sterile gel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionProbe" name="Position probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionPatient" name="Position patient"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" name="Choose vein identification method" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnatomicIdentification" name="Identify vein anatomically"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DopplerIdentification" name="Identify vein with Doppler"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompressionIdentification" name="Identify vein by compression"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" name="Continue after vein identification" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnesthetizePatient" name="Anesthetize patient"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PuncturePatient" name="Puncture patient"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBloodReturn" name="Check blood return"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BloodReturn" name="Is blood return correct?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DropProbe" name="Drop probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveSyringe" name="Remove syringe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallGuidewire" name="Install guidewire"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveTrocar" name="Remove trocar"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" name="Choose wire check axis" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" name="Check wire in long axis"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" name="Check wire in short axis"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheckMerge" name="Continue after wire check" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWirePosition" name="Check wire position"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WirePosition" name="Is wire in good position?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WidenPathway" name="Widen pathway"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdvanceCatheter" name="Advance catheter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveGuidewire" name="Remove guidewire"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VerifyFlowAndReflow" name="Verify flow and reflow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" name="Check catheter position"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Procedure" name="Procedure complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Prepare" sourceRef="StartEvent_Procedure" targetRef="Task_PrepareImplements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Wash" sourceRef="Task_PrepareImplements" targetRef="Task_WashHands"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wash_Clothes" sourceRef="Task_WashHands" targetRef="Task_GetSterileClothes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clothes_Clean" sourceRef="Task_GetSterileClothes" targetRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clean_Drape" sourceRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea" targetRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drape_Configure" sourceRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone" targetRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Configure_Gel" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" targetRef="Task_PutGelInProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gel_Cover" sourceRef="Task_PutGelInProbe" targetRef="Task_CoverProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cover_SterileGel" sourceRef="Task_CoverProbe" targetRef="Task_PutSterileGel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SterileGel_PositionProbe" sourceRef="Task_PutSterileGel" targetRef="Task_PositionProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PositionProbe_PositionPatient" sourceRef="Task_PositionProbe" targetRef="Task_PositionPatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PositionPatient_IdentificationSplit" sourceRef="Task_PositionPatient" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identification_Anatomic" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" targetRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selectedIdentification = 'anatomic'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identification_Doppler" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" targetRef="Task_DopplerIdentification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selectedIdentification = 'doppler'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identification_Compression" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" targetRef="Task_CompressionIdentification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selectedIdentification = 'compression'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Anatomic_IdentificationMerge" sourceRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Doppler_IdentificationMerge" sourceRef="Task_DopplerIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compression_IdentificationMerge" sourceRef="Task_CompressionIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentificationMerge_Anesthetize" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" targetRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Anesthetize_Puncture" sourceRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient" targetRef="Task_PuncturePatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Puncture_BloodCheck" sourceRef="Task_PuncturePatient" targetRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodCheck_BloodGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn" targetRef="Gateway_BloodReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodIncorrect_Puncture" name="Not correct" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturn" targetRef="Task_PuncturePatient">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not bloodReturnCorrect</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodCorrect_DropProbe" name="Correct" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturn" targetRef="Task_DropProbe">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bloodReturnCorrect</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DropProbe_RemoveSyringe" sourceRef="Task_DropProbe" targetRef="Task_RemoveSyringe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RemoveSyringe_InstallWire" sourceRef="Task_RemoveSyringe" targetRef="Task_InstallGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallWire_RemoveTrocar" sourceRef="Task_InstallGuidewire" targetRef="Task_RemoveTrocar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RemoveTrocar_WireCheckSplit" sourceRef="Task_RemoveTrocar" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheck_LongAxis" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selectedWireCheckAxis = 'long'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheck_ShortAxis" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selectedWireCheckAxis = 'short'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LongAxis_WireCheckMerge" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShortAxis_WireCheckMerge" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheckMerge_PositionCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckWirePosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PositionCheck_PositionGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckWirePosition" targetRef="Gateway_WirePosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WirePosition_Bad_Puncture" name="Not in good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePosition" targetRef="Task_PuncturePatient">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not wireInGoodPosition</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WirePosition_Good_Widen" name="In good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePosition" targetRef="Task_WidenPathway">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wireInGoodPosition</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Widen_Advance" sourceRef="Task_WidenPathway" targetRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Advance_RemoveWire" sourceRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" targetRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RemoveWire_VerifyFlow" sourceRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" targetRef="Task_VerifyFlowAndReflow"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VerifyFlow_CheckCatheter" sourceRef="Task_VerifyFlowAndReflow" targetRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCatheter_End" sourceRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" targetRef="EndEvent_Procedure"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
